system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids

Scoundrels have a habit of fleeing starports with the authorities on their heels. When a captain cannot leave a crew member back at the ship, a Remote Starship Starter comes in handy. A Droid equipped with this radio transmitter can signal the ship to begin the preflight processes; the ship transmits preflight diagnostics back to the Droid as a Free Action. Although the Droid is not able to operate the ship remotely, having the ship prepared for departure can save the crew vital minutes during an escape.
system.source: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids
